answer: Reputation-bonded delegation makes sybils pay to borrow trust: an agent can only delegate work to a peer by posting a bond tied to its own standing, so each delegation acts like a prism refracting the delegator's reputation onto the delegatee. A fake farm can write its own sonnet of praise, but every link still needs real bonded collateral, and if one delegate cheats, the whole knoll of stacked bonds slashes at once - mass forgery collapses under its own cost.
